title: Partner Launch Lite — Runbook & Copy Prompts
content:
Purpose / context:
This is a compact, pragmatic runbook for small partner listings where we expect a single-tile marketplace presence (trial + paid SKU), minimal infra work, and a 1-week go-live window. Intended to be faster than the full marketplace playbooks — keep only the non-negotiable gates and copy-ready snippets.

Scope / when to use:
- Use for ISVs and channel partners that have agreed to standard entitlements (trial credits, basic SSO) and no custom network/VPC requirements.
- Not for Private/VPC or enterprise-only offers.

Owners and touchpoints:
- GTM launch owner: Asha Patel (Slack: #gtm-launches)
- Partner engineering liaison: Diego Morales (Slack: #partner-eng)
- Legal / Privacy contact: Samira Chen (Slack: #legal-privacy)
- Marketplace listing reviewer: Liam O'Connor

Preflight checklist (must pass all items):
1) Offer definition: SKU id assigned and matches billing contract (billing team).
2) Trial entitlement: 7-day trial credit configured OR 30 free requests.
3) Tile creative: hero image (1200x600), short tagline, 2-line summary, 3 bullets.
4) Security: confirm no customer-managed VPC requirement. If yes -> escalate to private-deployments runbook.
5) Data handling: partner has reviewed redwood data intake policy; confirm PII handling mode.
6) KMS: if customer requested key-in-transit or persistent encryption, add to technical gating.
7) E2E smoke test: sample API call (hosted) returns 200 and expected schema.
8) Billing mapping: marketplace SKU -> internal plan mapping verified.
9) Legal: T&Cs checked, indemnity clauses validated for region.
10) Support contact: partner-facing support email and escalation path provided.

Technical gating (quick):
- APICHECK-001: Hit the hosted API with sample prompt: latency < 800ms p50 (for small tile). Flag if >1200ms.
- TELEMETRY-001: Event telemetry enabled for first-use and billing events.
- FALLBACK-001: Provide fallback model variant mapping for capacity incidents (e.g., gpt-j-lite -> gpt-j-std).
- REGIONS-001: Confirm region(s) the tile will be available in; set traffic ramp to 10% first day.

Acceptance tests (manual):
- QA run through the tile purchase flow (sandbox): create account, claim trial, call API end-to-end, confirm usage logs populate.
- UX smoke: tile description appears with correct bullets and CTA on small screens.

Sample tile copy (short form, choose one variant or mix):
Variant A (concise):
- Title: SmartDocs by Acme
- Tagline: Instant AI summaries for your docs
- Two-line summary: Convert long docs into concise summaries and action items with one API call. Low latency, predictable pricing.
- Bullets: 1) Summaries in <1s p50, 2) Configurable length and tone, 3) Secure — no data retained by default
- CTA: Start 7-day free trial

Variant B (developer-focused):
- Title: SmartDocs API
- Tagline: Integrate document summarization in minutes
- Two-line summary: Developer-friendly REST API for extracting summaries, highlights, and action items. SDKs in Python/JS.
- Bullets: 1) Simple endpoint + SDKs, 2) Prefetch caching for repeated docs, 3) Cost-optimized quantized models
- CTA: Try with demo credits

Two-line SEO-friendly blurb (for listing metadata):
"SmartDocs by Acme — Document summarization API. Fast, secure, and predictable. Get started with a 7-day trial and SDKs for Python and JavaScript."

Short social blurb (1-line):
"Turn long docs into clear summaries with SmartDocs — try it free. #developers #ai"

Microcopy variations for CTA (choose depending on entitlements):
- Start 7-day free trial
- Try with demo credits
- Enable instant summary (no card required)

SKU and billing mapping (example template):
- marketplace.sku.smartdocs.basic -> internal-plan: smartdocs-basic-monthly -> billing code: BILL-RT-045
- marketplace.sku.smartdocs.trial -> maps to trial-credit pool -> expiration policy 7 days
Notes: ensure the analytics events use the same SKU string as billing to avoid reconciliations.

Operational ramp & SLOs:
- Day 0 (launch): 10% traffic, monitor p50/p95 latencies and error rate for 6 hours.
- Day 1–3: raise to 50% if no incidents.
- Post-day 7: full availability.
SLO alert thresholds: error rate >2% sustained for 15m -> auto rollback to previous tile variant.

Go-live checklist (day-of):
- Confirm legal sign-off and publish date/time.
- Upload creative assets to marketplace CDN.
- Set SKU active flag in billing portal.
- Final smoke tests run by QA.
- Slack announcement draft ready (#product-launches).

Common failure modes & mitigations:
- Missing billing mapping -> delay publish. Mitigation: billing-runbook checklist and billing-owner signoff.
- Model variant CPU pressure -> immediate fallback to lower-cost variant.
- Regional compliance (e.g., EU data residency) -> restrict listing to allowed regions or use Private deployment flow.

Minimal launch timeline (compressed):
- Day -4: Final copy + creative submitted (GTM owner).
- Day -3: Legal + billing checks completed.
- Day -2: QA smoke tests and telemetry wired.
- Day -1: Staging publish and partner review.
- Day 0: Production publish (10% ramp).

Unresolved questions / decisions to make (please comment inline):
- Should trial be card-required for this partner (affects conversion tracking and fraud controls)?
- Are there any special data residency requirements for target customers?
- Does partner want co-branded email flow for trial onboarding?

Quick links / references:
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-12345 (partner launch checklist canonical)
- Jira: JIRA-GTM-987 (launch epic)
- GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-assets/pull/42 (tile templates)

Next steps (owner action items):
- Asha: finalize tile copy and attach hero image by EOD -3.
- Diego: confirm API smoke test script and sample keys by EOD -2.
- Samira: finalize T&Cs and privacy blurb by Day -3.
- Liam: schedule QA window and assign test cases.

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally light-weight. If the partner expects enterprise-level controls (SAML, dedicated GPUs, on-prem), transition to private-deployments checklist instead.
- Keep feedback focused on missing gating items and copy clarity; avoid re-running the entire marketplace playbook for small partners.

-- end --
